observations.value: More prominent reticular opacities are visible in the right lower lung zone compared to the left lower lung zone on the PA view (Figure 1a); this is corroborated by the magnified right lower lobe view (Figure 1d), which shows dense reticulation near the diaphragm, while the left lower zone in Figure 1a appears relatively less involved.
